title: Causal Integrated Gradients: Scalable Feature Attribution Along Causal Paths
abstract: arXiv:2610.22126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing feature attribution methods that account for feature dependencies do not scale to high dimensions. We propose causal integrated gradients (CIG) and causal expected gradients (CEG), which extend integrated gradients to incorporate prior causal structure among input features while retaining its computational efficiency and, under conditions on the causal graph, its axiomatic guarantees. In many settings, some causal structure between features is already known, for example, that a transcription factor causally regulates a target gene's expression. Yet existing gradient-based methods cannot exploit this structure, instead crediting a feature's downstream effects over its true upstream cause, such as ranking the target gene above the transcription factor that regulates it. translated_title: 因果积分梯度：沿因果路径的可扩展特征归因
translated_abstract: 现有的考虑特征依赖关系的特征归因方法无法扩展到高维场景。我们提出了因果积分梯度和因果期望梯度（CEG），它们对积分梯度方法进行了扩展，以纳入输入特征之间的先验因果结构，同时保持其计算效率，并在因果图满足一定条件时保留其公理化保证。在许多场景中，特征之间的某些因果结构是已知的，例如转录因子因果性地调控靶基因的表达。然而，现有的基于梯度的方法无法利用这种结构，反而将归因功劳归于特征的下游效应而非其真正的上游原因，例如将靶基因排在调控它的转录因子之上。我们的核心思想是通过让积分路径沿因果图行进来嵌入这种因果结构。由此，该方法将每个特征的归因分解为……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出因果积分梯度（CIG）和因果期望梯度（CEG），通过沿因果图路由积分路径来利用特征间已知的因果结构，在保持积分梯度计算效率和公理化保证的同时实现可扩展的特征归因，避免将功劳错误归于下游效应而非真正的上游原因。
en_tdlr: We propose Causal Integrated Gradients (CIG) and Causal Expected Gradients (CEG), which extend integrated gradients by routing the integration path along a causal graph, exploiting known causal structure among features to achieve scalable and axiomatically sound feature attribution while avoiding crediting downstream effects over true upstream causes.
